name: molpha
description: Molpha oracle tools and the Molpha skill for agents. Testnet only (Solana Devnet and Sepolia). Dry-run on by default.

signer_backend.title: Signer
signer_backend.description: memory (local keypair), keychain (Privy or Turnkey), or none. Leave empty, with no keypair, for a read-only server that cannot sign or spend.

owner_keypair.title: Keypair file
owner_keypair.description: Signer memory only: a dedicated testnet Solana keypair file. Never a wallet you use elsewhere.

keychain_backend.title: Keychain provider
keychain_backend.description: privy or turnkey, when the signer is keychain.

privy_app_secret.title: Privy app secret
privy_app_secret.description: Privy keychain only. Stored in your system credential store.

privy_wallet_address.title: Privy wallet address
privy_wallet_address.description: Privy keychain only: the wallet's base58 Solana address.

turnkey_api_private_key.title: Turnkey API private key
turnkey_api_private_key.description: Turnkey keychain only. Stored in your system credential store.

turnkey_wallet_address.title: Turnkey wallet address
turnkey_wallet_address.description: Turnkey keychain only: the wallet's base58 Solana address.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: Preview every write and payment instead of sending it. While on, a tool call cannot turn it off: to spend, untick this and restart.
